title: Will CTV Advertising Continue Its Reign in 2022?

facts.fact: The article 'Will CTV Advertising Continue Its Reign in 2022?' was published on December 19, 2021.
The article 'Will CTV Advertising Continue Its Reign in 2022?' was published on December 19, 2021, by Anton Liaskovskyi.
The author, Anton Liaskovskyi, is identified as CEO of AdPlayer.Pro.
The article states that digital ad industry buzz in Q1 and Q2 2021 centered on customer data and obtaining it after the deprecation of third-party cookies.
facts.quote: Most of the digital ad industry buzz in Q1 and Q2 2021 centered around customer data and legitimate ways to obtain it upon the deprecation of third-party cookies.

facts.fact: The article states that attention in the second half of 2021 shifted to the metaverse.
facts.quote: But the second half of the year was all ears on metaverse.

facts.fact: The article states that the CTV sector has shifted its development focus to programmatic advertising over the past 12 months.
facts.quote: the CTV sector has been rapidly shifting the focus of its development to programmatic advertising over the past 12 months.

facts.fact: The author predicts that individual CTV operating system operators' market shares are unlikely to grow large enough to form data monopolies.
facts.quote: the share of each OS operator on the market isn’t likely to grow big enough to form data monopolies.
